title: Schema entropy rescue and telemetry gapfix for private upgrade failures
creator: Marisol Vega
description:
Summary: Multiple Private (VPC/on-prem) customer clusters experienced partial failures during the 2025-09 operator/helm upgrade window. Symptoms: operator reconcile loops, stale KV schema in tenant shards, and a gap in telemetry ingestion (heartbeat/upgrade events) causing our incident detection to miss early signals. Impact: affected customers saw degraded serving (intermittent 503s during rollout), loss of short-lived prefix caches, and manual intervention required to restore tenant traffic.

Root cause hypothesis: A timing window in the operator upgrade path where controller-manager applied a CRD migration that changed the KV shard projection while nodeagents were still reconciling older CRs. This produced divergent in-memory schemas (schema entropy) and left some tenants in a partial state. Simultaneously, the metrics exporter crashed on certain nodeagent image build variants, creating a telemetry gap.

Goal: ship a targeted hotfix for operator/helm that: 1) introduces a safe pre-upgrade preflight check that verifies nodeagent/metrics exporter readiness and CR schema compatibility, 2) provides an automated rescue reconciliation step to detect and repair schema entropy without full tenant rollback, and 3) restores telemetry coverage and backfills missing upgrade/heartbeat events so our alerting and SRE runbooks function.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Preflight blocks upgrades with mismatched nodeagent/metrics-exporter versions and surfaces clear remediation steps in the console.
- Rescue job (operator controller) can detect divergent KV schema versions and apply a non-destructive repair path (schema projection + integrity checks) in staging clusters within 15 minutes for 95% of test tenants.
- Metrics exporter crash loops are mitigated and telemetry backfill pipeline ingests the missing 48h window for affected clusters in test environment.
- Automated test coverage: end-to-end onprem upgrade test that includes simulated network flakiness, image pull delays, and CRD projection skew.
- Customer communication: status update and a step-by-step remediation runbook published to affected customers and the support portal.

Notes: This ticket covers engineering implementation and release of the hotfix. Customer-facing follow-ups (billing credits, postmortem) will be tracked in a separate PM ticket.
repro_steps: 1) Provision a minimal private tenant cluster with operator v1.14 and nodeagent v3.2 images.
2) Introduce a synthetic delay on nodeagent startup (container sleeps randomly 30-90s) to emulate slow nodes.
3) Trigger helm upgrade to operator v1.15 that includes CRD projection change for tenant.kv.v2.
4) Observe reconcile logs; on affected nodes, the operator applies the new projection while nodeagents still report old schema, producing KV mismatches and partial tenant readiness.
5) Confirm metrics exporter on one node is crashing due to a missing env var introduced in the image build variant to reproduce telemetry gap.
investigation_notes: 2025-09-12 10:12 UTC - Initial customer escalation from support: tenant serving degraded during scheduled upgrade window. (Support SR: SR-8542)

Checked operator logs: repeated 'apply projection' events followed by nodeagent heartbeats missing for a subset of pods; kvcache entries show inconsistent schema_revision values across the tenant shard.
Heap of nodeagent memory unchanged; no segfaults. Metrics exporter process restarted repeatedly on nodes with image sha abc123 that lacked the new METRICS_NAMESPACE env var.
Repro in staging using image sha abc123 and preflight disabled reproduced schema drift within 2 of 10 runs when nodeagent startup delay > 25s.
Telemetry: Grafana dashboard upgrade-events shows a 1h gap for some clusters; alerting silence was due to exporter crash not firing heartbeat metric.
remediation_plan:
Short term (hotfix):
- PR #2789: operator: add preflight hook that queries nodeagent /health and validates schema_revision parity before CRD projection commit.
- PR #2791: nodeagent: harden metrics exporter to tolerate missing env vars and emit fallback heartbeat metric.
- Ship private-2025.10.1 rollout with staged canary to 5% tenants, monitor reconcile latencies and kvcache divergence metrics.

Medium term:
- Add 'rescue-v1' operator controller that runs a safe schema reconciliation algorithm (detect divergent projections, compute minimal projection patch, run idempotent migration with pre/post checks and rollback markers).
- End-to-end test harness: add onprem upgrade test that injects startup delays and image-variant crashes to CI cycle.
- Telemetry backfill job to rehydrate missing upgrade-events for affected tenants using operator audit logs and helm release metadata.

Operational runbook snippets:
- If a tenant shows >10% kvcache schema skew across pods: 1) run operator rescue dry-run (non-destructive) on staging replica, 2) if dry-run passes, schedule 10m maintenance window and run rescue with strict tracing enabled, 3) if rescue fails, perform tenant snapshot quarantine and restore traffic to last-known-good node pool.
